ssc_groups.name: IUCN SSC Primate Specialist Group
ssc_groups.description:
Chair: Russell Mittermeier (email: rmittermeier@globalwildlife.org)
Red List Authority Focal Points: 
Prosimians, monkeys and smaller apes - Sanjay Molur (email: sanjay@zooreach.org) and Christoph Schwitzer (email: cschwitzer@bristolzoo.org.uk)
Vice-Chair for great apes - Dirck S. Byler (email: dbyler@globalwildlife.org)
Vice-Chair for small apes - Susan M. Cheyne (email: section.small.apes@gmail.com)
Journals and Newsletters: 
Primate Conservation: http://www.primate-sg.org/primate_conservation/
Neotropical Primates: http://www.primate-sg.org/neotropical_primates/
Asian Primates: http://www.primate-sg.org/asian_primates_newsletter/ and http://www.primate-sg.org/asian_primates_journal/
Lemur News: http://www.primate-sg.org/lemur_news/
African Primates: http://www.primate-sg.org/african_primates/
